component.name: Yatzé!
component.summary: Roll five dice, fill thirteen boxes

description.p: The classic five-dice game for GNOME. Every roll is real tumbling physics, filmed from your seat at the table, then the dice line up so you can read them. Play alone, with friends at one computer, or against computer players; the hardest of them plays perfectly.

ul.li: Full rules: upper bonus, Yatzé bonuses and the Joker
Live hints from an exact strategy engine: what to keep, which box to take
Computer players at three levels, mixed freely with people
The dice poured from a leather cup into a wooden tray, with real shadows and sound
Turn the table to look from any side; a cheer for every Yatzé
Your scores over time, high scores and every player's record
Red or ivory dice, undo for holds and boxes, full keyboard play

description.p: Yatzé! is not affiliated with Hasbro's Yahtzee.

screenshot.caption: A roll pours from the cup
Hints: what to keep, which box to take

description.p: Dice no longer pass into each other, through the cup, or bounce off thin air above the tray.
A quicker pace for computer players; the window remembers its size; screen-reader support.
First release: the full game, computer players, hints, 3D dice with sound, high scores and your record over time.
The logo; whose turn it is; scores fly into their boxes.
A Yatzé gets a cheer; so does the end of the game. A sound button.
The dice cup, and real cast shadows.
Dice sounds, and a wooden tray around the table.
Physics dice, computer players, hints and high scores.
